rubrics.justification: The response correctly identifies a very poor-quality early blastocyst with absent/degenerative ICM and poor TE, but it overstates certainty about blastocoel size and comments on features not fully assessable from the image; zona/overall architecture detail is incomplete.
The visible response is truncated after morphology and does not meaningfully integrate age, BMI, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, prior IVF history, or sperm parameters with embryo prognosis.

The morphology discussion is internally mostly coherent, but the response is incomplete and includes some inconsistency between the provided 1DD label and its own interpretation of expansion without fully reconciling this.

What is shown is broadly consistent with Gardner-style interpretation of a poor-quality blastocyst, but the incomplete response prevents assessment of transfer recommendations or full evidence-based alignment.
No practical transfer or future-cycle recommendations are visible in the provided response excerpt.
